review: PMSV CTR R28 source identity audit
note: Identity standard, definition, licensing direction, or wrong-article guard is not a full contaminant panel or finished-product CTR article adjudication; original notifications prevail over compendia in conflict.

records.scope_note: An analogue involves milk constituent replacement by non-milk ingredient and functional/organoleptic resemblance. A category label alone does not establish exact product composition.
records.forbidden_inference: Never inherit ordinary milk/cream/cheese/ice-cream CTR rows purely from dairy analogue category; exclude wholly non-dairy coconut milk from this analogue definition.
records.minimum_evidence: Reference dairy product, actual milk fat/protein replacement, full formula, exact analogue subtype/FoSCoS category, manufacturing process, matrix and independently selected CTR article.

records.product_name: Frozen Desserts or Confections with Added Vegetable Oil/ Fat or Vegetable Protein, or both
records.scope_note: Separate standard for frozen desserts/confections using vegetable fat/protein, with defined frozen and dried mix variants.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not silently equate with ice cream; equally do not assert similar frozen confections CTR exclusion without original source adjudication.
records.minimum_evidence: Check actual frozen versus dried mix product, vegetable oil/protein composition, milk solid inclusion, ready-to-consume/reconstituted analytical matrix and precise CTR article.

records.scope_note: Coconut-kernel-derived milk, cream or powder has its own product standard. Milk/powder formulations may permit sodium caseinate/maltodextrin; check the actual recipe.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not transfer contaminant limits from cow milk, coconut water or coconut oil just because of name or common source.
records.minimum_evidence: Identify coconut kernel content, exact final form, added caseinate/maltodextrin or other ingredients, processing, primary container, moisture/dry analytical basis and exact CTR source article.

records.product_name: Edible Dried Seeds obtained from Fruits
records.scope_note: Licensing categories were created as interim measures for edible dried fruit/vegetable seeds; this is not itself a numeric product standard.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not turn licensing category into a commodity-specific contaminant MRL, or automatically activate the 2026 edible seed proposal as final.
records.minimum_evidence: Exact botanical species, fruit-versus-vegetable seed, edible processed form, current final notification status, correct raw commodity/pesticide residues and analytic matrix.

records.source_clause: CTR Version IX, Metal Contaminants 2.1.1, Lead table, Cocoa powder row
records.scope_note: The named lead source row is for Cocoa powder measured on dry fat-free substance basis; this is not a blanket cocoa-bean/carob rule.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not apply cocoa-powder 5 mg/kg dry fat-free substance to whole cocoa beans or carob powder.
records.minimum_evidence: Exact botanical article and processing, fat basis, matrix-specific contaminants/pesticides, original notification article and validated testing.

records.scope_note: Singhare ka atta is flour made from dried Trapa bispinosa/Trapa quadrispinosa nuts.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not inherit raw root/tuber vegetable or canned chestnut metal/MRL articles.
records.minimum_evidence: Botanical Trapa species certificate, origin and raw dried nut processing, final flour analytical matrix, relevant commodity/legal article and source-based MRL method.

records.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
records.scope_note: Colostrum is separately defined as early cow/buffalo mammary secretion preceding milk; product form matters.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not directly apply ordinary milk/dehydrated-milk CTR limits without a valid source article.
records.minimum_evidence: Identify cow/buffalo origin, early colostrum vs dried/based product, actual recipe, residue definition, relevant veterinary/milk-specific articles and validated sample basis.

records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
records.scope_note: Purified drinking water sold through water vending machines is distinct from packaged drinking water and natural mineral water; IS 10500 referenced.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not inherit packaged-water/mineral-water contaminant articles or apply an unfinalized draft amendment.
records.minimum_evidence: Confirm water vending machine scope (not captive installation), source and treatment, applicable IS 10500 results, validated method, effective amendments and any exact CTR article.
